h2. Description

*A technician without a photo should show as a light-grey circle with dark grey initials.* On staging it is a solid blue circle with white initials, in Board View column headers and in the Reassign lead technician dialog.

For example,
* a Board View column header for a technician with no photo shows a solid blue circle with white initials (e.g. "ZD")
* in the Reassign lead technician dialog every technician without a photo shows the same solid blue circle

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10046*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Board View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
#* A column header for a technician without a photo shows a solid blue circle with white initials.
# On any card open *More actions* (…) > *Reassign lead technician*.
#* The technicians without a photo show solid blue circles with white initials.
# Click *Cancel*.

*Actual Result:*
* No-photo avatars are solid blue with white initials.

*Expected Result:*
* A light-grey circle with dark grey initials, as the test expects: *"Step 3: the six-dot grip, a light-grey circle with the initials in dark grey (not a solid blue circle with white initials), the name in dark semibold text, a grey outline pin icon, a short divider, the clipboard icon and the number, as in the design picture."*
